parameters: A child's voice: "Mama says don't open the door!"
The door is locked. Piano music drifts out.
A note: "Gone to the harbor - back at sundown."
An old woman calls: "Wipe your boots first!"
The door is locked. A cat watches from the window.
Shall I light them? Or put them out for the day?
Turnips for the inn, cabbages for the tavern.
And pumpkins for the Harvest Festival!
Laundry day. If it rains, I'm blaming the wizards.
The Snowblade lady can cut a falling leaf in half!
We've fed the ducks in this pond for forty years.
There are no ducks. We feed them anyway.
This canal runs from the castle moat to the sea.
The townhouse with red roof belongs to Lady Mirelle.
She lets rooms to travellers, they say.
The light on the pond at dusk... if only I could paint it.
Bawk! The hen pecks at the turnips.
